description: This file contains unit tests for Abseil's memory utilities, including testing of unique_ptr wrapping, raw pointer utilities, custom allocators, and destructor verification classes.

classes.name: DestructorVerifier
classes.description: A class to verify destructor calls via instance count.

classes.name: InitializationVerifier
classes.description: A struct that fills memory with patterns upon allocation for testing initialization states.

classes.name: ArrayWatch
classes.description: A struct that tracks array allocations.

classes.name: IntPointerNonConstDeref
classes.description: A class wrapping an int pointer with non-const dereference.
